name: What are the common types of properties available to international buyers in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of properties available to international buyers in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: International buyers in South Florida often consider luxury condominiums in areas like Aventura, Sunny Isles Beach, or Brickell, as well as single-family homes in communities across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties. Investment properties, such as vacation rentals, are also popular. The best choice depends on whether you seek a primary residence, a seasonal home, or an income-generating asset, and Kelby Contreras specializes in helping buyers identify the right property type for their goals across these diverse areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common properties include luxury condos, single-family homes, and investment properties, with choices depending on your intended use and location preferences.
